rtt_step_pattern.observation: RTTs in this CONTROL run fall on levels about 20 ms apart: {'26 ms': 79, '46 ms': 79, '66 ms': 82, '86 ms': 84, '106 ms': 83, '126 ms': 3, '146 ms': 4, '326 ms': 1} (counts of the 415 selected values by nearest level). The P95 of 105.894 ms is on the 106 ms level. The same pattern is present in the 11 other runs with 415 selected values: concentration R 0.834 to 0.998, share within 3 ms of the ladder 0.870 to 1.000; this run has R 0.918 and share 0.952.
rtt_step_pattern.measure: Circular concentration of RTT modulo 20 ms (R: 0 = even, 1 = all on one phase) and the share of values within 3 ms of the phase centre (a flat spread would give about 0.30).
rtt_step_pattern.status: Observation only. The cause is not established; an earlier working suspicion is system timing granularity. It is kept as a flag so the thesis analysis does not read the steps as network effects.
